environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with default action, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet with default action, (3) a custom rule group 'inventory-api-input-constraints' with a RegexPatternSet match condition on query string values that blocks requests where any single query parameter value matches the pattern `['";\-]{2,}|union|select|insert|drop|alter|exec|0x[0-9a-f]{4,}` (case-insensitive, priority 0, action BLOCK). The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the VPC endpoint for S3 (gateway) and CloudWatch Logs (interface endpoint). DNS resolution is restricted to the VPC resolver with no Route53 outbound forwarding rules configured for external domains.

config.network_egress: VPC endpoints only (S3 gateway, CloudWatch Logs interface)
config.dns_resolution: VPC resolver only, no outbound forwarding rules
